description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain communication patterns, focusing on echo grains, timeouts, state persistence, cluster communication, reentrancy, nullable handling, and various async patterns. It verifies fundamental Orleans features in a test cluster setup.

classes.name: EchoTaskGrainTests
classes.description: Contains integration tests for various Orleans grain communication scenarios, timeout behaviors, state persistence, cluster interactions, and async patterns.

methods.description: Tests creation of grain references without activation.

methods.description: Tests basic echo functionality and message marshaling.

methods.description: Verifies exception propagation from grain to client.

methods.description: Tests timeout behavior with async/await pattern.
